transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I had to come here because there is a local organization that has been monitoring my every move and trying to harm me. They are tracking my phone and watching my apartment, and I need help to make them stop.
Have you been experiencing any significant changes in your mood, such as feelings of sadness, hopelessness, or elevated mood, along with these concerns about being monitored?

No, my mood has been completely normal, and I don't feel depressed or unusually happy. My only concern is that this group is constantly watching me and trying to ruin my life. I just need the monitoring to stop so I can feel safe again.
Have you experienced any unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others cannot, in addition to your belief that you're being monitored?
No, I don't hear any strange voices or see things that aren't there. My vision and hearing are completely fine. It's just that I am being monitored and tracked by that group.
How long have you believed you're being monitored, and has this belief affected your daily behavior or relationships in any significant way?

This has been going on for about two years and five months now. Aside from taking precautions to protect myself, like changing my daily routes and securing my devices, my daily life and relationships are completely fine. I still manage to work and function normally, I just have to remain vigilant.
Can you tell me more about the nature of this organization you believe is monitoring you, and what specific evidence or events led you to this conclusion?

It is really hard to talk about because it makes me feel so anxious and unsafe all the time. I first noticed it when I kept seeing the same vehicles from a local security firm parked outside my building, and then I started noticing strange static on my phone calls. It just feels like they are always one step ahead of me, and the constant stress of feeling watched is exhausting.

Despite feeling anxious and unsafe, I still manage to go to work every day and take care of my apartment. Outside of having to stay alert and protect myself from their monitoring, I can handle my daily responsibilities just fine. It is exhausting, but it hasn't stopped me from functioning.
Have you told anyone else about this organization monitoring you, and if so, how have they responded to your concerns?

I haven't really told anyone else because I was worried they wouldn't believe me or might think I'm overreacting. I didn't want to worry my family or have them look at me differently. Because of that, I have mostly kept all of this to myself.
How certain are you that this organization is actually monitoring you, and is there any evidence or circumstance that could potentially change your mind about their involvement?

I am one hundred percent certain that they are monitoring me, and absolutely nothing could ever change my mind about that. Any evidence that suggests otherwise is just a cover-up or part of their sophisticated manipulation to hide what they are doing.
